subject: COI format clarification and PO-stub guidance
messages:
From: Diego Fernandez <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@sagecloud.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-17T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: COI format clarification and PO-stub guidance

Hi Elena —

Thanks for moving this along. We started the intake for SageCloud and I need a quick clarification on the COI you emailed earlier. A few asks to get the onboarding queue moving: 

- Re-issue the COI with an endorsement that names "Redwood Inference, Inc." as Additional Insured (AI).
- Include a Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference.
- Show primary and non-contributory wording on the endorsement.
- Policy limits: General Liability 1M/2M preferred; Auto and Employers Liability as shown.
- Carrier name and NAIC number on the cert.
- Certificate holder block should read:
  Redwood Inference, Inc.
  Attn: Vendor Onboarding
  2211 Mission St, San Francisco, CA 94110

Also, please attach your completed W-9 and a current subcontractor list if you expect to engage subs. Once we receive the corrected COI/endorsement and W-9, Procurement will issue a conditional PO stub (to allow billing) — we typically can do that within 48 business hours after endorsement confirmation.

If you want, here's the exact language our Legal prefers for the endorsement (paste into your broker request):
"Redwood Inference, Inc., its officers, directors, employees and agents are named as Additional Insured with respect to General Liability on a primary and non-contributory basis. Waiver of subrogation is included where permitted by law."

Can you confirm ETA on the re-issue? If you need a sample PO-stub, Monica is CC'd and will attach.

Thanks,
Diego Fernandez
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference

Elena —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and for attaching the broker cert. A few clarifications: please request the endorsement as a separate PDF (endorsement form) rather than relying on remarks in the cert box — the carrier endorsement is easier for our Risk team to process. The endorsement PDF should reference the policy number shown on the COI.

Use this exact Additional Insured text for the endorsement: 

"Redwood Inference, Inc., a Delaware corporation, its officers, directors, employees and agents are to be named as Additional Insured with respect to General Liability on a primary and non-contributory basis. A waiver of subrogation in favor of Redwood Inference, Inc. is included where permitted by law."

For the certificate holder block please use the full legal/PO billing address (see below) — that helps Procurement match invoices to the PO: 
Redwood Inference, Inc.
AP/PO Team
2211 Mission St
San Francisco, CA 94110

Monica — can you confirm we'll issue a conditional PO stub once the endorsement PDF and W-9 are posted? If yes, please attach the PO-stub we typically provide to vendors so Elena can reference it. Marissa, if there are any legal redlines to the endorsement language above, happy to incorporate.

Thanks — pushing this should keep SageCloud on track for the May 25 start.

Diego
Vendor Operations | Redwood Inference

Confirming Procurement will issue a conditional PO stub once we receive:
- Signed endorsement PDF naming Redwood Inference, Inc. as Additional Insured with primary and non-contributory language
- Completed W-9 (we've received your initial W-9, thanks)

Procurement timeline: conditional PO stub issued within 24 business hours of receiving the endorsement; final PO issued after Risk signs off (usually 2–3 business days barring carrier delays).
